reading.body:
This Stamford facility is described by its operator as an office and data center, but no power capacity is published. Without a megawatt figure, it is not possible to assess whether this campus has material relevance to AI infrastructure scaling.

Connecticut has five mapped data center facilities, of which only two publish power capacity figures totaling 8 MW. This campus ranks third by published capacity in the state, but that ranking reflects the absence of published data rather than confirmed scale. The state context suggests most facilities in Connecticut do not disclose their specifications publicly.

To determine whether this campus matters to AI, a reader would need to contact the operator directly for power capacity, IT load density, and grid interconnection details. The published record contains none of these facts.
